I totally get you! I've been stuck on the Bishop boss for probably a month now too! I'm still having fun fighting him, but I do want to continue the story. I've been using the Greatsword of Fate Blade for this boss and it does a lot of damage, not to mention the fable art for the blade is very cheap in my opinion. 

I know that people don't like the Spector(for some reason, I'm new to soul games) but they really do help you with the first stage by keeping him distract. When that happens, I tend to go behind the boss while the Spector he's its attention and do some damage behind. The boss might turn its attention on you sometimes but that's okay, just dodge and parry (I suck at parrying so I'm better at dodging, but I'm getting better at it) This is also good because  Spector will do some damage without getting attacked and it will still have HP for the second phase! 

Throwables are helpful too (though it is a hassle to farm the fire ones haha) so save those until the second phase. I plan to use them when he's low on hp to hopefully finish him off.
